home.role: commercial gateway for robot rental demand
home.requiredH1Pattern: Commercial H1 contains owner-approved high-frequency service intent such as “Аренда роботов …”.
home.titlePattern: Brand + primary commercial keyword; no unapproved superlatives.
home.primaryKeywordRule: One approved high-frequency commercial cluster; usually аренда/прокат роботов.
home.firstBlockRule: First visible block answers who, what service, for which events, and how to request selection.
home.aiSummaryRule: 80–220 visible chars summarizing brand, service, event use cases, and next action for AI extraction.
home.ctaRule: Primary CTA to request/contact; secondary to catalog/подборки. No live routing implication beyond approved forms.
home.schemaRule: Organization + WebSite; ItemList when catalog/promo lists are visible.
home.internalLinksRule: Link to robot catalog/cards, Подборки, Блог Кибер Гоши, contacts/request.
home.factualSafetyRule: Only approved brand/contact/service claims; do not imply availability/prices for all models.

robot_card.requiredH1Pattern: Pattern: “Аренда {robotName}” or approved close equivalent with rental intent visible.
robot_card.titlePattern: Robot name + rental/event intent + КИБЕР ПОРТАЛ; preserve approved title if visual copy differs, but record mismatch.
robot_card.primaryKeywordRule: Model-specific commercial query: аренда/прокат/заказать {robotName}; do not invent search volume.
robot_card.firstBlockRule: First block must answer what model is, rental availability, scenarios, operator/logistics boundary, and price status if approved/request-only.
robot_card.aiSummaryRule: Short answer for AI: model, service context, suitable scenarios, price status, what manager clarifies.
robot_card.ctaRule: Lead/request CTA with robot/scenario context; price CTA must not claim unapproved package.
robot_card.schemaRule: Service + BreadcrumbList; FAQPage only when visible FAQ exists; Offer only for approved public prices.
robot_card.internalLinksRule: Related robots, categories, Подборки, articles, contacts/request.
robot_card.factualSafetyRule: Prices from approved tariff source only; capabilities with source status; no invented autonomy, movement, language, or venue claims.

category.requiredH1Pattern: Category name + rental/category intent, e.g. “Гуманоидные роботы в аренду”.
category.primaryKeywordRule: Mid-frequency category/service query; not a single model query.
category.firstBlockRule: First block defines category, when to use it, and points to model list.
category.aiSummaryRule: Category-level answer: what robots are in the class, common scenarios, how to choose.
category.ctaRule: CTA to selection/request plus model cards.
category.schemaRule: CollectionPage + ItemList + BreadcrumbList; FAQPage if visible FAQ.
category.internalLinksRule: Robots in category, related categories, Подборки/articles, contacts/request.
category.factualSafetyRule: Do not claim every robot fits every scenario; category copy must defer uncertain selection to manager.

compilation.role: scenario/theme landing page built from source “сборка” materials
compilation.requiredH1Pattern: Scenario/theme phrase + robots/rental intent where natural, using public label Подборки in navigation.
compilation.titlePattern: Theme + robots/аренда + КИБЕР ПОРТАЛ; avoid source word “Сборка” in public title unless owner approves.
compilation.primaryKeywordRule: Scenario/theme query, not only model query; may be commercial or informational-commercial hybrid.
compilation.firstBlockRule: First block states the occasion/scenario, who it is for, and what robot formats are compared/recommended.
compilation.aiSummaryRule: AI summary names scenario, recommended robot formats, selection logic, and request path.
compilation.ctaRule: CTA to discuss scenario; catalog/product block links to approved robot cards.
compilation.schemaRule: CollectionPage + ItemList + BreadcrumbList; FAQPage if visible FAQ.
compilation.internalLinksRule: Robot cards, related articles, other Подборки, category pages, contacts/request.
compilation.factualSafetyRule: Catalog prices must be sourced; scenario recommendations must not overpromise venue outcomes or availability.

article_index.requiredH1Pattern: Index H1 is section label, currently “Блог Кибер Гоши”; no need to force individual article keyword.
article_index.primaryKeywordRule: Section-level informational/commercial-support query; not one article keyword.
article_index.firstBlockRule: First block explains what the blog contains and how to use articles to choose robots.
article_index.aiSummaryRule: AI summary describes section scope and links to article/detail pages.
article_index.ctaRule: CTA to articles and contact/request; no fake article count promises.
article_index.schemaRule: WebPage or Blog; ItemList recommended when article cards exist.
article_index.internalLinksRule: Article detail pages, robot cards, Подборки, contacts/request.
article_index.factualSafetyRule: Index copy must not pretend unpublished article detail pages exist publicly.

article_detail.requiredH1Pattern: Specific article headline; contains the primary query naturally, not keyword stuffing.
article_detail.titlePattern: Article title + КИБЕР ПОРТАЛ; may include scenario/model if truthful.
article_detail.primaryKeywordRule: One article-level query mapped to archetype: scenario, price explainer, ideas/listicle, or comparison.
article_detail.firstBlockRule: Hero + intro must answer the user’s search question within first 1–2 paragraphs.
article_detail.aiSummaryRule: 80–220 char extractable answer: what the article explains, involved robots/scenarios, and when to contact manager.
article_detail.ctaRule: Gosha quote or CTA near end plus contextual links to robot cards/request.
article_detail.schemaRule: Article or BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList; FAQPage when visible FAQ exists.
article_detail.internalLinksRule: Related articles, robot cards, Подборки/category hubs, request/contact.
article_detail.factualSafetyRule: Generated article claims start as needs_review; price/model specs must reconcile to source-of-truth before publication.

news_index.requiredH1Pattern: Section H1 such as “Новости” or approved КИБЕР ПОРТАЛ news label.
news_index.titlePattern: News index + КИБЕР ПОРТАЛ; avoid article/detail claims.
news_index.primaryKeywordRule: Freshness/news section query; not model rental keyword unless section copy supports it.
news_index.firstBlockRule: First block explains what news/events are collected and links to items.
news_index.aiSummaryRule: AI summary gives section scope, publication policy, and source context.
news_index.ctaRule: CTA to related service pages only when news item context supports it.
news_index.schemaRule: WebPage or CollectionPage + ItemList; not NewsArticle for index alone.
news_index.factualSafetyRule: No invented dates, participants, awards, venues, or client names.

news_detail.requiredH1Pattern: Specific event/news headline; includes date/context where appropriate.
news_detail.primaryKeywordRule: News/entity query or event-specific informational query.
news_detail.firstBlockRule: First block states what happened, when, where, source/evidence, and why it matters.
news_detail.aiSummaryRule: AI summary gives factual who/what/when/where without promotional invention.
news_detail.ctaRule: Contextual CTA only after factual report; link to relevant robot/service if directly related.
news_detail.schemaRule: NewsArticle + BreadcrumbList; images with factual alt/source.
news_detail.internalLinksRule: Related robot/service pages, articles, categories, source links if public.
news_detail.factualSafetyRule: Every factual claim needs source/date; no fabricated client/event details.

contacts.requiredH1Pattern: Contacts H1; no need to force commercial keyword unnaturally.
contacts.firstBlockRule: First block exposes approved ways to contact and what happens after request.
contacts.aiSummaryRule: AI summary lists approved contact channels and service scope.
contacts.ctaRule: CTA to request/contact methods; no unapproved live routing assumptions.
contacts.schemaRule: ContactPage; Organization/LocalBusiness only with approved legal/business data.
contacts.internalLinksRule: Legal pages, request page, home, catalog.
contacts.factualSafetyRule: Use only approved public contacts/requisites; do not expose secrets or internal routing.

legal.requiredH1Pattern: Legal document H1; exact document title.
legal.primaryKeywordRule: Legal/navigational intent; do not optimize for robot rental unless naturally relevant.
legal.firstBlockRule: First block states the document scope and effective context.
legal.aiSummaryRule: AI summary names document type and scope without changing legal meaning.
legal.ctaRule: CTA optional; links to contacts/legal set.
legal.schemaRule: WebPage; specific legal schema only after legal review.
legal.internalLinksRule: Contacts, related legal documents, request pages if relevant.
legal.factualSafetyRule: Do not rewrite legal copy for SEO; no commercial keyword stuffing.

conversion.requiredH1Pattern: Action H1: request, thanks, next step; not a landing keyword target.
conversion.firstBlockRule: First block explains current action, expected next step, and privacy boundary.
conversion.aiSummaryRule: AI summary explains request/thanks function; no false promise of live CRM.
conversion.ctaRule: Primary form/contact action only where approved; thanks page next links.
conversion.schemaRule: WebPage; noindex policy may apply by route.
conversion.factualSafetyRule: Do not imply production lead routing, analytics, or secret changes unless separately approved.
